target.title: Toolcontainer owns sandbox image
target.test: The sandbox Dockerfile must live under apps/toolcontainer and compose must build from that app.

steps.expected: docker-compose.yml builds ndx-sandbox from apps/toolcontainer and the Dockerfile preserves the existing sandbox runtime packages and apply_patch helper.

target.passCriteria: The Docker sandbox is represented as an app without changing the sandbox contract.

target.expected: docker-compose.yml builds ndx-sandbox from apps/toolcontainer and the Dockerfile preserves the existing sandbox runtime packages and apply_patch helper.

steps.descript: Compose builds the sandbox from apps/toolcontainer and the Dockerfile keeps the original runtime contract.
evidence: Dockerfile installs bash, git, jq, patch, python3, ripgrep, wget, xz-utils, Playwright Chromium, and /usr/local/bin/apply_patch.
npm run deploy built hika00/ndx-sandbox:0.1.1 and verified the sandbox write.

result.descript: The Docker sandbox build context is now represented as apps/toolcontainer.
